title: fix(swf): morph tween ratio off-by-one — last tween frame never reaches ratio=65535
description:
In `packages/swf/src/compile.ts` around line 1662, the linearT denominator is `spanLen` (= endFrame - startFrame + 1) instead of `spanLen - 1`.

Bug: `const linearT = spanLen <= 1 ? 0 : frameOffset / spanLen;`

At the last tween frame (`frameIdx === endFrame`), `frameOffset = spanLen - 1`, so `linearT = (spanLen-1)/spanLen` which is always < 1.0. For a 10-frame tween, the last in-span frame gets ratio=~59050 instead of 65535. The morph only reaches its final shape at the END keyframe (which falls through the span check and gets hardcoded 65535), not at the last tween frame.

Fix: change denominator to `spanLen - 1`:
```ts
const linearT = spanLen <= 1 ? 0 : frameOffset / (spanLen - 1);
```

Evidence: compile.ts:1660-1662, getTweenSpans returns endFrame = nextKeyframe.index - 1 (timeline-query.ts:112), so endFrame IS the last tween frame and should yield ratio=65535.
